'Acetate Young Guns' (127 rows, cardNumbers 201-249 / 451-499 / 701-729) PARTIALLY overlaps base-set-young-guns's own numbers at 701-729 with the SAME 29 players (ground-truthed against the real planStagedDirectory: staging it as its own category made the run REFUSE with an id collision against base-set-young-guns at the plain address, because the shared 29 numbers carry a blank parallel on both sides) while the REMAINING 98 of its 127 rows (201-249, 451-499) have no base counterpart at all -- so it is not a clean subset-of-base fold either (ruled out: most of the rows would be silently dropped). '2023-24 Update - Acetate Young Guns' (29 rows, cardNumbers 701-729) is a full roster of LAST year's rookies reprinted at THIS year's Young Guns numbers -- 0 of 29 players agree with base-set-young-guns at those same numbers (measured directly), so it is unambiguously its own insert, not a parallel of anything staged here. Per the task's own instruction ('insert sets needing unregistered keys: hold via manifest with roster-overlap evidence'), held for a separate additions-only productSetKeys.ts PR (candidate keys: upper-deck-extended-series-acetate-young-guns, family/parent upper-deck-extended-series; upper-deck-extended-series-2023-24-update-acetate-young-guns, same family) rather than guessed into either shape.
